meta.title: Extending an expired stage without reopen permission is refused with 496
gaps: the case needs a caller who is not a super admin (or lacks a permission), and every run acts as the client's own super-admin buyer — a refusal it expects may legitimately not happen

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to reopen an expired event”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Extending an expired stage without reopen permission is refused with 496

expected.message: You are not allowed to reopen an expired event
